entities.name: Jerusalem Delivered
entities.label: Text
entities.summary: Epic poem by the italian poet torquato tasso first published in 1581; tells a mythified account of the first crusade in which christian knights led by godfrey of bouillon battle to take jerusalem Created by Torquato Tasso. Created c. 1575.
